description: This file defines the LocationStats class, which provides methods to gather statistical counts related to location data within the Goteo project, such as counting unlocated/located items, filtering items, and grouping counts by various attributes.

classes.name: LocationStats
classes.description: A class that offers statistical methods to analyze location-related data, including counts of located and unlocated items, filtered counts, and grouped counts by various attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LocationStats object with a LocationInterface instance and a Model instance.

methods.name: countUnlocated
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the model that are not present in the location.

methods.name: countLocated
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the model that are located.

methods.name: countUnlocable
methods.description: Returns the count of items that are not locable (filtering by 'locable' equals zero).

methods.name: countFiltered
methods.description: Returns the count of items filtered by a specific key-value pair, with optional inversion.

methods.name: countGroupFiltered
methods.description: Returns an array of counts grouped by a specified attribute, filtered by key-value pairs.

methods.name: countGroupCountries
methods.description: Returns an array of counts grouped by country, concatenating country code and country name.
